qti.review:
QTI sir is simply the best
Follow his class and note his examples and that's it.
Make sure you make a strong group and avoid plagiarism in any, LITERALLY ANY, homework or report.

I did MGT489 with him and trust me you won't regret it!

MGT489- Qti
Lecture : everything onek joss bujhay. Sir, possible way jotoprokar ache sob way te bujhanor try kore. Bangla te lecture dey also. And, use so much example in class. So, bujha onek easy hoye jay.
Exam System and Pattern : No quiz. Take some practice case. You will solve it in a group.
Mid 1, Mid 2, and Final. Mid1, Mid 2 and Final e MCQ + Written thake. For mcq, you have to read the slides, his lectures and books perfectly to ensure a good marks. For written, his question is very simple. Use example as much as possible. Write everything perfectly. Donot write any types of unnecessary point. You will get a good marks.
Ethics Assignment, Group Report and Presentation : In MGT489, he takes two group report. First is Ethics Assignment. You have to find out a case first and then solve this case here. Eta group based work. Onr instruction follow kore korben.
Group Report e ekta company visit kore setar upor report likhte hobe and strategy create korte hobe for next 5 years. Etao group wise.
**** Donot do Plagariasm and donot use any types of AI in both report. Group wisely niben, plagariasm and AI jate sir konovabei na pay, sir eta onek onek hate kore. Eta korai jabe na. Boro percent e plagiarism dhora khele your group can get 0 out of 10or 20.
Presentation : Sir er presentation e time management is so much important. 2 minutes pabe every member. So, er cheye beshi bolle marks deduct korbe..
Grading : Fair. Sir, excel sheet e final er marks soho sob kichu upload kore dibe. Just last e 1/2 grade curve kore final grade submit kore dibe.
Qti is good. Just make sure u have a good group who doesn’t plagiarize. Sir is very strict about plagiarism any copied or AI contents can lead to a zero in the assessment.
